supplier_origin_roster_consistency.name: supplier_origin_roster_consistency
supplier_origin_roster_consistency.value:
("supplier"."origin" = 'imported' AND "supplier"."roster_name" IS NOT NULL AND "supplier"."roster_index" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("supplier"."origin" = 'discovered' AND "supplier"."roster_name" IS NULL AND "supplier"."roster_index" IS NULL)

citation_exactly_one_target_group.name: citation_exactly_one_target_group
citation_exactly_one_target_group.value:
("citation"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + ("citation"."record_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + ("citation"."enrichment_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + ("citation"."criterion_value_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + ("citation"."match_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + (("citation"."shortlist_program_id" IS NOT NULL AND "citation"."shortlist_category_id" IS NOT NULL))::int = 1

round_one_owner.name: round_one_owner
round_one_owner.value:
("round"."match_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + ("round"."assessment_version_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      + ("round"."recommendation_version_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

sentence_one_owner.name: sentence_one_owner
sentence_one_owner.value: ("sentence"."assessment_version_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("sentence"."recommendation_version_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1
